intent: Calm competence: the viewer notices the finished lawn first, then the headline.

model.why: start + end keyframes, 21:9, newest in its family on the roster that day

shot.composition: house on the right third, lawn leading lines from bottom left, sky and open lawn on the left

camera.move: push-in and orbit then crane up

path.start: wide with the full facade and front lawn
path.end: the same framing 60 cm closer, horizon unchanged

lens.focus: deep focus held on the facade

lighting.key: low golden-hour sun from camera left, long soft shadows across the lawn

motion.subject: none
motion.secondary: grass tips and one tree branch move in a light breeze
motion.environment: thin sprinkler mist drifts left to right in the far background
motion.parallax: foreground grass blades pass faster than the facade

color.grade: warm highlights, neutral greens, soft contrast; matches --c-accent

negatives: no geometry warping on the roofline
